  END SEM EXAMINATIONS - NOV/DEC 2023  
  Computer Organization and Architecture [ECE-2152]  
  Marks: 50                                                                                Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           Write a program using 3, 2, 1 and 0 address instructions for the following. Assume  
  source and destination operands are memory locations. Write comments for each step.  
  (4)  
  $$Y= (A-B)*(C+D)/E$$  
  A)  
  B)      With the help of block diagram explain general register based computer organization and  
  give suitable example instructions.                                                     (3)  
  
  C)      With the 11-bit instruction length and 4-bit address field, verify the possibility to have  
  five 2-address, Forty five 1-address and thirty two 0-address instructions.                   (3)  
  
  2)           Explain the working of carry look ahead adder, Carry select adder and Carry save adder  
  in detail.  
  (4)  
  A)  
  B)      Draw the Wallace tree structure for adding 7 single bit numbers. Give the advantage of  
  having Wallace structure in the Execution unit.                                               (3)  
  
  C)      Draw the Wallace tree structure for 7 single bit operand CSA. Write the expression for  
  finding the number of CSA levels for the same.                                                (3)  
  
  3)           Explain the method of non-restoring method of division with the help of a flow chart.  
  Divide 7 by 3 using this method. Show all the iterations.  
  (4)  
  A)  
  B)      Add 0.5 and 0.4375 using 32-bit IEEE floating point representation and write the result  
  in 32-bit IEEE format.                                                                        (3)  
  
  C)      Build a hardware to implement each of the following register transfers. Assume A, B, C  
  and X are 4-bit registers.  
  (3)  
  If X is even, then            else  
  
  4)           Explain in detail standard I/O and memory-mapped I/O. Also explain programmed I/O             (4)  
  approach for I/O communication.

  B)       A computer main memory consists of 1024 blocks of 256 words each. The cache  
  memory has eight sets of each having four blocks(lines). Determine and show the tag  
  field size of main memory address for the following mapping techniques. (i) Fully           (3)  
  associative mapping, (ii) Direct mapping  
  
  C)       A set associative cache consists of 64 slots divided into 4-slot sets. Main memory  
  contains 4K blocks of 128 words each. Show the format of the main memory address.           (3)  
  
  5)            Compare the architectural features of CISC, RISC and VLIW architectures.  
  (4)  
  A)  
  B)       A non-pipelined processor is operating at a clock rate of 2.5 GHz and average cycles per  
  instruction of five. The processor is upgraded to a six-stage pipelined processor, but the  
  clock speed for this processor is reduced to 2 GHz due to internal pipeline delay. If there (3)  
  are no stalls in the pipeline, then determine the speed up achieved in this pipeline  
  processor.  
  
  C)       Explain the characteristic features of three bus structure organization. Mention its  
  advantages and disadvantages.                                                               (3)
